holdings.name: Schwab US Broad Market ETF
holdings.risk: Falls with the whole US market; offers no shelter in a broad selloff.
holdings.thesis: The entire US stock market at 0.03% a year — maximum diversification per dollar.

holdings.name: Schwab International Equity ETF
holdings.risk: Currency swings and long stretches of lagging the US can test your patience.
holdings.thesis: Developed international stocks so the portfolio is not a bet on a single country.

holdings.name: Schwab US Aggregate Bond ETF
holdings.risk: Loses value when interest rates rise; meager real returns for long stretches.
holdings.thesis: Investment-grade ballast that steadies the portfolio and funds rebalancing when stocks fall.

holdings.name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
holdings.risk: Lumpy enterprise spending; growth is modest even when execution is good.
holdings.thesis: The plumbing of the internet — networking gear with a shareholder-friendly dividend.

holdings.name: Coca-Cola Co.
holdings.risk: Slow growth; sugar taxes and health trends nibble at volume over time.
holdings.thesis: The most reliable cash register in consumer staples; dividends raised for 60+ years.

holdings.name: Verizon Communications Inc.
holdings.risk: Heavy debt and brutal wireless competition cap the upside.
holdings.thesis: Boring in the best way — steady wireless cash flows and a substantial dividend.

holdings.name: US Bancorp
holdings.risk: Credit cycles hit banks first; recessions punish earnings and the stock together.
holdings.thesis: A conservative, well-run super-regional bank with a long dividend record.

holdings.name: Pfizer Inc.
holdings.risk: Drug development is binary — the pipeline may disappoint after the patent cliff.
holdings.thesis: Trades cheaply with a strong dividend while the post-patent-cliff pipeline rebuilds.

holdings.name: CSX Corp.
holdings.risk: Freight volumes fall in recessions, exactly when the rest of the portfolio hurts.
holdings.thesis: An eastern US railroad is a toll road on the economy — hard to replicate, easy to understand.

holdings.name: Exelon Corp.
holdings.risk: Rate-sensitive; regulators, not markets, set the allowed returns.
holdings.thesis: Regulated utility — the dependable dividend is the thesis.

holdings.name: Unilever PLC (ADR)
holdings.risk: Currency drag and emerging-market volatility come with the global footprint.
holdings.thesis: Global staples brands plus non-US diversification in a single ADR.

notes: SAMPLE / EDUCATIONAL portfolio sized near $10,000 with all holdings under ~$70/share. Edit targetWeight, shares, costBasis, thesis and risk freely — the dashboard recomputes everything from this file.
